scan: four benchmark kinematic points; zero, pole, and running-width prescriptions; 12 rows total
width_model: conditional Dirac chi2, real scalar, pure scalar, single open chi2->chi1+s channel; vector-sector self-energy not included
validation: Regression tests are included and must be run by the PR workflow. Local standalone results are provisional until the workflow executes against the baseline repository kernel.
limitations: No AFH Sigma-prime, Sigma-double-prime, or Delta response has been numerically contracted with the three-body tensor.
The pointlike spin-zero current includes centre-of-mass convection only, not internal nuclear currents.
The per-nucleon vN and q/(2mN) factors are kinematic estimates, not AFH nuclear-response ratios.
No mediator propagator, halo integral, isotope abundance sum, detector response, or likelihood is included.
